name: Fire Bolts
description: Prepared crossbow bolts carrying incendiary charge for controlled ignition or destructive strike delivery.
narrative_effects: Supports ignition and fire-delivery framing through compatible crossbows.
Usually destroyed or stripped of special function after firing.

mechanical_effect.trigger: fired from a compatible crossbow at a target or material that can plausibly ignite or be affected by delivered flame
mechanical_effect.applies_to: checks to ignite vulnerable materials, create fire pressure, or deliver fire through a crossbow shot
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: nonflammable or soaked targets; situations where fire would not help; ordinary accuracy beyond the fire-delivery purpose
